title: Baobab Tenant-Organisation and Tenant-LegalEntity Mapping Contracts (ADR-BCP-018)
description:
Definition library for TenantOrganisationMapping and TenantLegalEntityMapping.
Validate resources against fragment URIs (e.g. #/$defs/TenantLegalEntityMapping), not the document root.

Explicit mappings are the long-term source of truth (ADR-BCP-018 sections 50-52). The active TenantLegalEntityMapping with mapping_role DEFAULT is the compatibility projection exposed as the singular Tenant.LegalEntityID; at most one may be active per tenant at any instant (enforced by Control Plane persistence).

tenantLegalEntityMappingRole.description: ADR-BCP-018 section 51. DEFAULT marks the version-1 compatibility projection of Tenant.LegalEntityID.

TenantOrganisationMapping.description: Explicit Organisation-to-Tenant mapping. Mapping an Organisation to a Tenant grants no data access to any other Organisation in its corporate group or PlatformAccount.

provenance.description: How this mapping was established (admission, backfill, governance reconciliation, etc.).

TenantLegalEntityMapping.description: Explicit LegalEntity-to-Tenant mapping. For first-party identities legal_entity_id must exist in contracts/legal-entity/registry.yaml; external identities are Control-Plane-issued and need not.

provenance.description: How this mapping was established (admission, backfill, governance reconciliation, etc.).
